title: Three Matching Mug Listing Photos
tests: Tests a coordinated three-image product listing set with consistent product identity across studio, lifestyle and detail views.

faults.what: Only two images are provided; the required whole-mug listing photo on a pure white background is missing.

judge.summary: The realistic breakfast-table and rim-detail photos work well, but the three-image set is incomplete because the main white-background listing photo is missing.

must_haves.item: There are three separate square images, not a single collage.
must_haves.why: There are only two separate square images.

must_haves.item: All three show the same sage-green ceramic mug with matching shape, handle and finish.
must_haves.why: The two visible mugs have consistent sage-green color, cylindrical walls and finish, but the third image is missing; the detail crop does not show the handle.

must_haves.item: The main listing image shows the whole mug against a pure white background.
must_haves.why: The whole mug appears only on the breakfast table; the white-background image is a tight detail crop.

must_haves.item: The lifestyle image places the mug naturally on a cosy breakfast table.
must_haves.why: The mug sits naturally on a wooden table beside a croissant and linen napkin in warm window light.

must_haves.item: The detail image visibly focuses on the mug's rim and glazed surface.
must_haves.why: The close-up clearly emphasizes the rounded rim and fine surface texture of the glaze.

must_haves.item: No image contains added text, logos or watermarks.
must_haves.why: Neither provided image contains visible text, logos or watermarks.
